name: sim_clifford_spinor_double_cover_micro

micro.function_surface: clifford.Cl(3) even rotor sign and vector sandwich action
micro.micro_claim: In Cl(3), a unit even rotor R and its sign partner -R induce the same sandwich action on vectors, while the rotor signs remain distinct as spinor-adjacent representatives.
micro.lego_target: minimal Cl(3) Spin(3) double-cover sign fixture; pre-lego only
micro.why_this_lego: The fixture isolates the sign-equivalence gate needed before any later spinor-adjacent Clifford work can use rotor representatives safely.
micro.positive_case: A unit rotor and its negative produce identical vector sandwich outputs for several test vectors.
micro.negative_case: A non-unit even multivector is excluded by the unit norm gate and by vector norm drift under sandwich action.
micro.boundary_case: Identity, 2*pi sign flip, and 4*pi return preserve the vector action boundary.
micro.demotion_condition: Demote this Clifford surface if R and -R differ on any tested vector sandwich action by more than 1e-10, if either sign fails the unit norm gate, if a non-unit even candidate is admitted, or if boundary identity/2*pi/4*pi behavior fails.
out_of_scope: bridge, coexistence, topology-variant, emergence, or axis-level claims
